authorization.request: 处理 GitHub 作者回复并完成已授权的商城下架；修复阻止公开发布的确定性构建错误。

incident.error: Rankings snapshot exceeds the 1 MiB bound

invariants: Preserve every ranking entry, order, field and pagination behavior.
Use one exported byte bound for the builder, browser reader and Pages prior-snapshot reader.
Bump the ranking module URL so the browser cannot retain the previous one-megabyte reader from cache.
Reject empty, malformed, or over-bound prior snapshots; never reset chart history on invalid input.
Do not modify Catalog admission, author state, DSH source, Profiles, or third-party code.

verification: Offline static marketplace build using the prior snapshot from a preserved disposable output directory
Pages deployment and independent GitHub, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn readback

recovery.history: The source change is committed on an auditable PR branch; revert the merged PR in a separate CI-checked PR if the deployed health check fails.
recovery.externalMutation: No Catalog, DSH Profile, or author-contact mutation is part of this source fix.
